layers.description: Non-renderable primitive and semantic tokens, accessibility and content rules.
A single-purpose, independently accessible building block.
A stable, small composition with one clear responsibility.
A distinct, purposeful section assembled from atoms and molecules.
A responsive page-level layout with named regions and representative content.
A real route, data and content instance of a reviewed template.

guardrails: A layer may use only registered lower-level components and documented slots.
Accessibility, semantic content and responsive behaviour are hard constraints at every layer.
The AI may select catalog values and composition patterns, never arbitrary HTML, CSS, JavaScript, URLs or component types.
Atomic Design is a classification and composition model, not a mandatory linear delivery sequence.
